rule: T1/T2 are Operational Families. O1-O6 are historical T1 regime/templates, not Family identities. Capabilities and hardness mechanisms never become task surfaces by themselves.

task_surfaces.semantics: Maintain source-required monitoring information availability under the active reporting contract.
task_surfaces.closure: Historical O1 is replayable and physical-equivalent to deterministic comply; no standalone decision-hardness claim.

task_surfaces.semantics: External authority changes the active monitoring/reporting cadence; newly released obligations follow the source-defined warning/grade contract.
task_surfaces.closure: Localized O2 control consumption was unique-ready in A7. The external warning transition remains valid as a workload/obligation-arrival axis; set_sampling/report_period is not itself a research task.

task_surfaces.semantics: Maintain monitoring delivery across finite terrestrial service loss/recovery using authorized heterogeneous fallback paths.
task_surfaces.closure: One-shot permanent recovery / outage+two-path variants are closed by deadline-aware reserve+EDF or ordinary fallback. Only non-nested finite opportunities plus shared obligations/resources may re-enter hardness mining.

task_surfaces.semantics: Preserve authorized monitoring obligations under source/trace-grounded energy scarcity and communication energy accounting.
task_surfaces.closure: Ordinary EnergyAware and dynamic-energy references exist; cache06 explicitly forbids claiming long-horizon/energy novelty from the historical O4 template alone. Energy may bind compositional cases but must not be an invented global quota.

task_surfaces.semantics: Retain monitoring records locally during communication loss according to source-required storage semantics.
task_surfaces.closure: DZT0450 requires at least seven days of cache. Retention itself is deterministic conformance; cache capacity must not be artificially shrunk to manufacture hardness.

task_surfaces.semantics: After reconnect, restore source-required monitoring availability and reconcile in-flight/uncertain delivery state without inventing backlog priorities.
task_surfaces.closure: Historical O5 control consumption was unique-ready in A7. DZT0450 says cached data are sent as required but does not define a general backlog-vs-fresh sacrifice priority; such priority-sensitive cases are OBJECTIVE_AMBIGUOUS unless another source resolves them.

task_surfaces.semantics: Use source-authorized terrestrial/satellite path classes and preserve any source-defined priority or fallback boundary.
task_surfaces.closure: Known path choice/ordinary fallback alone is not a decision-hard task. It becomes relevant only when legal observations, timing and shared resources make future feasibility differ.

task_surfaces.semantics: Compose monitoring obligations, warning-driven arrivals, intermittent opportunities, recovery state and finite resources in one continuous episode.
task_surfaces.closure: Historical O6 only proved runtime/conformance and must not be reused as a hardness claim. New cases must pass V0-V9 and strong-baseline gates after composition.

task_surfaces.semantics: Verify/authorize/publish a warning under the source authority chain and stage deadline.
task_surfaces.closure: Source-supported; old sensor-node simulator lacks warning candidate/verification/publication authority state.

task_surfaces.semantics: Deliver published warning through municipal/township/village/public responsibility chain with acknowledgement, retry and alternate channels.
task_surfaces.closure: Source-supported 15/15/30 minute handoff chain; requires actor graph, multi-recipient delivery and authority-gated transitions.

task_surfaces.semantics: Execute progressive region call-response and feedback logging while suppressing only source-authorized unchanged duplicates.
task_surfaces.closure: Source-supported 12/6/2h progression and 30/50min feedback; requires actor-chain and feedback-ledger environment.

hardness_mechanisms.role: paid evidence changes existence/cost of a common causal continuation
multiple obligations compete for actual opportunities/capacity/energy
at least two commitments interact across stages
dedicated query competes fairly with passive feedback and normal send-as-probe
